# nexspence_webhook (Resource)

An outbound webhook that POSTs repository/artifact events to a URL.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nexspence_webhook" "ci" {
  name   = "ci-pipeline"
  url    = "https://ci.example.com/hooks/nexspence"
  secret = var.webhook_secret # HMAC-SHA256 signing key (write-only)
  events = ["artifact.published", "repo.created"]
  active = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `events` (Set of String) Event types to deliver: [artifact.published artifact.deleted repo.created repo.updated repo.deleted proxy.error].
- `name` (String)
- `url` (String) Endpoint that receives the POST.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the webhook delivers events.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) HMAC-SHA256 signing key. Write-only — the API never returns it, so it is kept from config and never refreshed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
